sqlViews.name: Demo data status: aggregate
sqlViews.description: Data value counts by data set and org unit level. For checking that a demo/training database has data where expected. Works on all supported DHIS2 versions.
sqlViews.sqlQuery: select ds.name as dataset, ou.hierarchylevel as orgunit_level, count(dv.*) as datavalues, max(pe.enddate) as newest_period from dataset ds left join datasetelement dse using (datasetid) left join datavalue dv using (dataelementid) left join period pe on dv.periodid = pe.periodid left join organisationunit ou on dv.sourceid = ou.organisationunitid group by ds.name, ou.hierarchylevel order by ds.name, ou.hierarchylevel;

sqlViews.name: Demo data status: tracker (2.40)
sqlViews.description: Event counts and newest event date by program and org unit level. Run this variant on DHIS2 2.40 (programstageinstance table).
sqlViews.sqlQuery: select p.name as program, ou.hierarchylevel as orgunit_level, count(psi.*) as events, max(psi.executiondate)::date as newest_event from program p left join programstage ps using (programid) left join programstageinstance psi using (programstageid) left join organisationunit ou using (organisationunitid) group by p.name, ou.hierarchylevel order by events desc;

sqlViews.name: Demo data status: tracker (2.41-2.42)
sqlViews.description: Event counts and newest event date by program and org unit level. Run this variant on DHIS2 2.41 or 2.42 (event table).
sqlViews.sqlQuery: select p.name as program, ou.hierarchylevel as orgunit_level, count(ev.*) as events, max(ev.occurreddate)::date as newest_event from program p left join programstage ps using (programid) left join event ev using (programstageid) left join organisationunit ou using (organisationunitid) group by p.name, ou.hierarchylevel order by events desc;

sqlViews.name: Demo data status: tracker (2.43+)
sqlViews.description: Event counts and newest event date by program and org unit level. Run this variant on DHIS2 2.43 and later (trackerevent and singleevent tables).
sqlViews.sqlQuery: select p.name as program, ou.hierarchylevel as orgunit_level, count(*) as events, max(ev.occurreddate)::date as newest_event from (select programstageid, organisationunitid, occurreddate from trackerevent union all select programstageid, organisationunitid, occurreddate from singleevent) ev left join programstage ps using (programstageid) left join program p using (programid) left join organisationunit ou on ev.organisationunitid = ou.organisationunitid group by p.name, ou.hierarchylevel order by events desc;
